result:
Small order-utility module: `calcTotal` sums price×qty over items, `applyDiscount` applies a percentage for known codes (SAVE10/SAVE20), `averageItemPrice` divides total by item count, and `formatOrder` renders line items plus the discounted total.

Bugs:
1. `calcTotal` (orders.js:5) — off-by-one: `i <= items.length` reads one past the end, so `items[i].price` throws `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined` on every call. This breaks every function in the module since all depend on it.
2. `averageItemPrice` (orders.js:20) — returns `NaN` on an empty array (0/0), even if bug 1 were fixed.

Minor: `applyDiscount` treats codes case-sensitively (`save10` silently gives no discount), and no validation of missing `price`/`qty` — worth noting, but arguably by design.
